summary: Regenerative Medical Technology Group Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an investor video call held August 20, 2026. The filing discloses management's prepared remarks and Q&A transcript, primarily discussing the CEO's personal treatment experiences and the company's path to a potential Nasdaq listing. No financings, M&A activity, tender offers, or other special-situation events are announced. The 8-K is a routine disclosure of investor communications, furnished under Item 8.01, and does not constitute a special-situation category. The transcript confirms no actionable deal terms, board actions, or strategic restructuring were discussed.
